name: Kevin Hume
reason: His Perth Meditation Courses & Coaching site sells secular meditation chiefly on stress, pain, sleep and anxiety relief and on executive and workplace performance (course pages list pain management, sound sleep and improved health as outcomes; MP3s include Healing and Anxieties Release); judged more health-framed coaching than spiritual teaching under the strict health rule. A human may disagree: he has a published Northbridge base and email.
